_doc: Gold set for the tier-3 commitment extractor bake-off. Windows are lobby-shaped dialogue between A and B (B is always the user's side where it matters). expect=null means: a correct model outputs no commitment. what_contains are lowercase keywords the extracted 'what' must contain (any language). due_contains matches the raw due phrase. Traps are labeled in _why.
